# Turnmark

> Swimming time conversions, published standards, altitude adjustments and World Aquatics points, backed by one shared Rust engine.

The web calculator and publisher widget run calculations locally after loading.
The public read-only MCP server is https://mcp.turnmark.app/mcp over Streamable
HTTP, with no authentication or API key. Use an MCP client; browser GET at that
endpoint returns 405. Remote inputs are processed by Cloudflare. The local
stdio server runs calculations offline and does not make runtime network calls.

Tools: convert_swim, adjust_altitude, get_youth_standards, get_masters_target,
get_world_points and get_sources. Call get_sources for bundled editions,
coverage and attribution; these are published snapshots, not live records.
Preserve available, unavailable and invalid outcomes, actual destination event
distances, and published/derived labels. Converted estimates are not recorded
performances. Qualifying targets are benchmarks, not confirmation of entry
eligibility. Missing published data stays unavailable.

The MCP server cannot read or edit saved swims, profiles, files or browser
history. On HTTP 429, respect Retry-After. The service runs on Cloudflare Free;
temporary unavailability does not affect offline SDK or stdio calculations.
JavaScript packages: @turnmark/sdk@0.1.0 and @turnmark/mcp@0.1.0. The MCP
package depends on the SDK and provides the turnmark-mcp stdio executable.
WebMCP remains planned work.

## Integrations

- [MCP reference](https://turnmark.app/mcp/index.md): Remote client configuration, local stdio setup, tool inputs, result semantics and troubleshooting.
- [JavaScript SDK](https://turnmark.app/docs/sdk.md): Browser, Node and Wasm initialization, public APIs and current release status.
- [Widget setup](https://turnmark.app/embed/): Interactive preview, appearance choices and copyable iframe HTML for publishers.
- [Publisher widget](https://turnmark.app/docs/embed.md): Versioned iframe code, appearance, attribution, privacy and offline behavior.

## Calculation sources

- [Methodology](https://turnmark.app/docs/methodology.md): Source editions, covered events, conversion directions, rounding and limitations.

## Optional

- [MCP operations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Stanback/turnmark/main/docs/MCP.md): Transport implementation, verification, hosting and abuse limits.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/Stanback/turnmark): GPL-3.0-or-later source, native app development and contribution guides.
